generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: An open-class control suite can vary lexical novelty and structural shape independently yet miss the intersection, allowing a default-accept branch to survive only when two dimensions occur together.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Test unknown single members and known composite members separately, then treat an unknown composite member as valid because it is absent from a finite negative vocabulary.
trigger_signals: finite membership used as negative evidence
separate sibling tests without crossed combinations
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: For open classes, derive independent decision dimensions and exercise at least one crossed case such as lexical novelty plus structural depth; absence from a finite list is never positive semantic evidence by itself.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Audit open-class default decisions with an unseen lexical member in a deeper or alternate structure and pair it with an unseen positive boundary supported by explicit positive evidence.
